name: witches-desk-reader
description: A read-only ChatGPT connection to The Witch’s Desk writing workspace.

interface.longDescription: Read-only access to the signed-in Witch’s Desk account’s manuscripts, chapters, selected scenes, notes, characters, and worldbuilding. Start a temporary 30-minute connection from The Witch’s Desk. This plugin has no save, edit, restore, or delete tools.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the Witch’s Desk Reader to look up only the writing or story-planning material I ask about.
